steps.body: Two evens always make an even: 4 + 6 = 10. Both pair up cleanly, so their total does too. **even + even = even.**
steps.narration: Two evens always make an even: four plus six is ten. Both pair up cleanly, so their total does too. Even plus even is even.

steps.body: **odd + even = odd.** One leftover has no partner: 4 + 7 = 11. And doubles are always even — they pair perfectly.
steps.narration: Odd plus even is odd. One leftover has no partner: four plus seven is eleven. And doubles are always even — a number plus itself pairs perfectly.
